name: stop-motion
title: Stop Motion
description: An animation block in the page's dedicated stop-motion/ folder: upload or delete frame files (any continuous-numbering, gaps tolerated, filenames only), set the fps, and the block plays them as a pure-CSS stop-motion. The canvas modal manages frames end to end; the serve-time filter decodes the ````stop-motion fence (four ticks — the plugin-fence boundary; a three-tick fence is a code block, always) into stacked, CSS-only frames. BREAKING since 0.3.0: old three-tick stop-motion fences no longer decode — they stand as visible code; rewrite the opening line to four ticks. Malformed fences stay visible in the md: degrades, never dead.
